outcome: early postpartum hemorrhage (blood loss >= 300 mL within 2 hours post-delivery)
cohort: The study included 1,903 term parturients with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy admitted to Guangdong Women and Children Hospital.
finding: Epidural labor analgesia was identified as an independent risk factor for early postpartum hemorrhage within 2 hours post-delivery in parturients with gestational hypertension.
